sources.content: # AGENTS.md for Rillwick. Rillwick is a command line tool that copies container images between registries. It is written in Go 1.22. Build the binary with `make build`, which writes it to `bin/rillwick`. Run unit tests with `make test` and the registry integration tests with `make itest`; the integration tests start a local registry on port 5005 through Docker Compose. Never commit files from `testdata/cache/`, which the tests regenerate on every run.

Conventions. Command definitions live in `cmd/rillwick/` and use the cobra library, one file per subcommand. Flags use kebab case, such as `--dry-run`. Wrap every returned error with fmt.Errorf and the %w verb. Do not add a new third party dependency without an issue that a maintainer has approved. Run `make lint` before pushing; it runs golangci-lint with the config in `.golangci.yml`. Changelog entries go in `CHANGELOG.md` under the Unreleased heading.

claims.text: Rillwick's `make build` writes the binary to `bin/rillwick`.
Rillwick subcommands are defined with the cobra library.
Rillwick's integration tests start a local registry on port 5000.
